games:2026-wk10-miami-notre-dame.blurb: No. 1 Miami heads to South Bend as a 4.5-point underdog against No. 6 Notre Dame, with ESPN's model giving the Irish a 61% edge at home. The Hurricanes' spot atop the rankings is on the line in the marquee game of the week, with a total of 57.5 hinting at points.

games:2026-wk10-georgia-ole-miss.blurb: No. 2 Georgia is a field goal favorite in Oxford against No. 12 Ole Miss, and ESPN still makes it close to a coin flip at 55.5-44.5. The Rebels can scramble the SEC picture with a win; the Bulldogs can all but lock their grip on it.

games:2026-wk10-byu-utah.blurb: The Holy War carries real weight this year: No. 8 BYU at No. 4 Utah, with the Utes laid 5.5 and favored by ESPN at 65.7%. A low total of 45.5 points to a grinder, and the Big 12 race runs straight through it.

games:2026-wk10-kentucky-tennessee.blurb: No. 7 Kentucky visits No. 16 Tennessee as a 6-point underdog, with ESPN giving the Vols a 66.8% shot in Knoxville. The Wildcats' climb up the SEC ladder gets its stiffest road test yet.

games:2026-wk10-alabama-lsu.blurb: No. 9 Alabama goes to Baton Rouge for a rivalry night with No. 15 LSU favored by 4.5 and sitting at 57% in ESPN's model. Both teams need the result badly in a crowded SEC middle.

games:2026-wk10-texas-missouri.blurb: No. 11 Texas is a 3.5-point favorite at No. 19 Missouri, though ESPN likes the Longhorns far more than the number does at 71.3%. With the total set at 46.5, this one profiles as a defensive slog with ranking stakes for both.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-ucla-minnesota.blurb: No. 5 UCLA is a 6.5-point favorite at Minnesota with a tiny 38.5 total, so the Bruins may have to win this one ugly. ESPN gives them a 68% chance of keeping pace in the Big Ten race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oregon-ohio-st.blurb: No. 10 Ohio State hosts Oregon as a 9.5-point favorite, with ESPN putting the Buckeyes at 83.1%. After a slide in the rankings, Ohio State needs a statement performance in front of its own crowd.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-iowa-northwest.blurb: No. 20 Iowa at No. 23 Northwestern is the closest line on the board at 1.5, with the Wildcats a hair ahead in ESPN's model at 55.2%. The 42.5 total says whoever lands the one extra score probably wins it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-cincinnati-hou.blurb: No. 18 Houston is a 10.5-point home favorite over Cincinnati with a 62.5 total that suggests plenty of scoring. ESPN has the Cougars at nearly 84% to hold serve.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 13 Texas Tech is laying 16.5 at home against West Virginia, with ESPN giving the Red Raiders an 89.4% chance. The 63.5 total points to a scoreboard-spinning afternoon in Lubbock.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-virginia-tech-.blurb: No. 24 SMU hosts Virginia Tech as a 6.5-point favorite and a 68.2% pick in ESPN's model. The Mustangs are only barely holding their spot in the rankings, so style points matter.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-new-mexico-nev.blurb: No. 25 New Mexico hits the road at Nevada favored by 12.5, with ESPN giving the Lobos an 81% shot. A clean win keeps their first brush with the Top 25 alive.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-merrimack-wake.blurb: No. 14 Wake Forest welcomes Merrimack in a no-line tune-up. The Demon Deacons just need a tidy, healthy afternoon before the schedule tightens again.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 21 Boise State is an 18.5-point favorite at Colorado State and a 93.1% pick per ESPN, with the total up at 68.5. Anything short of a comfortable win would be a problem for the Broncos.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-tcu-arizona.blurb: No. 22 Arizona hosts TCU as an 8.5-point favorite, with ESPN putting the Wildcats at 73.8%. A 44.5 total suggests Arizona will need its defense to cover the margin.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed two spots to No. 5, but the computers remain unconvinced -- SP+ has the Bruins 17th and FPI 28th, the widest gap between poll and metrics in the top 10.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky is up to No. 7 from No. 9, yet sits 31st in SP+ and 26th in FPI. The models want proof, and a trip to Tennessee is the chance to supply it.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State tumbled from No. 2 to No. 10 in the rankings but is still No. 1 in SP+ and No. 2 in FPI. By the numbers, this is the most underrated team in the country right now.

predictions:utah.blurb: Utah moved up to No. 4 with the metrics roughly on board, sitting 10th in both SP+ and FPI. Beating BYU would help close what's left of that gap.

predictions:lsu.blurb: LSU held at No. 15 while ranking third in SP+ and fifth in FPI -- the models think the Tigers belong in the top five. Alabama at home is the resume game to back it up.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's auto bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 3 Indiana leads with No. 5 UCLA just two spots behind. One stumble from the Hoosiers and the Bruins are right there.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah holds the Big 12's auto bid at No. 4 with BYU four spots back at No. 8 -- and the two meet this week. The Holy War is effectively a playoff-seeding game.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia has the clearest cushion of any league leader, sitting at No. 2 with Kentucky five spots back at No. 7. The Bulldogs control the SEC's auto bid as long as they keep winning.

bubbleNotes:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss sits at the 13 seed, one spot outside the field, and draws the toughest possible fix: No. 2 Georgia at home. Win and the Rebels are in; lose and the margin gets thin fast.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU is the last team on the bubble at 16, four spots from the field, with No. 9 Alabama coming to Baton Rouge. It's a long climb, but there's no better opportunity on the schedule.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech holds the 14 seed, two spots out of the field, and hasn't moved. The Red Raiders need results elsewhere as much as their own.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest is stuck at the 15 seed, three spots from the field with no upward movement. Staying put won't be enough much longer.
